paragraphs: R. Avdimi of Sepphoris asked Rabbi Mana, Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot, chapter 4, mishnah 3. In Rabbi Chuna’s name, there; Ketubbot, chapter 1, halakhah 2. Rabbi Ammi was his father.
